reasons: Both answers get the core numbers right (50 MB/s, ~67 h, 29 h available, 360 GB/day, ~2 h per day of churn) and give similar week-ahead schedules with a freeze, a final --delete sync, verification and rollback. B checks the final step against the window more explicitly: it says at most ~360 GB fits in the 2-hour window, realistically ~180 GB, which is why the delta has to be kept small. It also sizes the first catch-up after the seed (~1 TB, ~6 h) and adds a Saturday rehearsal gate. A presents churn as 'not a problem' and never states outright that one day of changes would fill the whole window, though its Saturday 20:00 pre-sync handles that case in practice.
